build_kv_connector_logging: build a KVConnectorLogging instance to periodically log KV transfer metrics using a KVTransferConfig
observe_kv_connector_stats: observe transfer statistics and accumulate them in a KVConnectorLogging instance
log_kv_transfer_metrics: log accumulated KV transfer metrics by calling log on a KVConnectorLogging instance
build_kv_connector_prom: build a KVConnectorProm instance to register and record Prometheus metrics for KV transfer
observe_prometheus_metrics: observe transfer statistics and record them to Prometheus metrics via KVConnectorProm
